requirement.original: Fix deploy script: dedup old versions, fix slug extraction, fix date fallback, clean gh-pages
requirement.clarified: When deploying a new version for a destination, automatically delete older versions of the same destination in both gh-pages and /var/www/travel/. Fix slug extraction for multi-hyphen filenames. Fix date fallback for files without proper date suffix. Reduce index.html generation code duplication.
success_criteria: Each destination has only ONE version (latest) after deploy
Slug extraction works for multi-hyphen names like new-york-city-2026-03-15
Files without date suffix (e.g. china-exchange-bucket-list-2026) get consistent date, not today's date
Index generation code is shared between gh-pages and local deploy
gh-pages branch cleaned to match local state (3 plans, one per destination)
File size validation threshold lowered from 100KB to allow smaller valid plans

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Duplicate versions appearing for same destination

root_causes.issue: Date fallback uses $(date +%Y-%m-%d) for files without date suffix
root_causes.fix: Use file modification date instead of today's date

root_causes.issue: Slug extraction ${BASE_FILENAME%-*} only strips last hyphen segment
root_causes.fix: Use greedy regex to strip date suffix from end, keep full slug

root_causes.issue: No dedup - old versions never cleaned up
root_causes.fix: Before copying new version, delete all existing date dirs for same destination

root_causes.issue: Index HTML generation duplicated ~80 lines between gh-pages and local

critical: Shallow clone breaks dedup ordering - must use lexicographic sort of date dirs
'latest' fallback creates invisible index entries - DO NOT use 'latest', keep date format
major: Slug extraction bug: ${BASE_FILENAME%-*} breaks on multi-hyphen names
Atomicity gap: GitHub push and local copy not transactional
File size validation at 100KB rejects valid 88KB plans
